The subject is leash checks
Leash Check Notice

Travelers should confirm that every companion animal leash is secure, well fitted, and ready for handover before arrival at Aurelia Skyways. This helps the Companion Animal Travel Desk keep each journey orderly and calm.

Please review collars, leads, and any fastening points before you come forward. Keep the leash free from tangles and make sure the animal can be guided without strain. If your pet is nervous, the desk will assist in a steady and respectful manner.

A safety coordinator reviews common hazards and prevention steps as part of routine desk work. Safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and the staff will answer concerns in a warm professional tone. If you need guidance on leash handling or inspection, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before proceeding.
